# netbox_config_template (Data Source)

A NetBox config template (extras.configtemplate): a Jinja2 template rendered against a device's or virtual machine's config context.

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/extras/configtemplate/):

> Configuration templates can be used to render device configurations from context data. Templates are written in the Jinja2 language and can be associated with devices roles, platforms, and/or individual devices.

> Context data is made available to devices and/or virtual machines based on their relationships to other objects in NetBox. For example, context data can be associated only with devices assigned to a particular site, or only to virtual machines in a certain cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_config_template" "test" {
  name = "test-config_template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Serve the rendered output as a download.
- `created` (String)
- `debug` (Boolean) Render with Jinja2 debugging enabled.
- `description` (String)
- `environment_params` (String) Parameters for the Jinja2 environment, as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `file_extension` (String) File extension of the rendered output.
- `file_name` (String) File name of the rendered output.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mime_type` (String) MIME type of the rendered output.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `template_code` (String) Jinja2 template code.
- `url` (String)
